result.document_summary: A mid-document portion of a code-publisher page of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 2, Government) covering special event provisions (§§ 22.4034-22.4038) and the Securities Disclosure Division 41 (Disclosure Practices Working Group, §§ 22.4101-22.4111), despite the URL referencing the algorithmic rent price-fixing section.
result.notes: This part contains no residential rental rules in the six in-scope categories. It covers special event permits and the City's securities disclosure working group. The URL slug refers to San Diego's prohibition of algorithmic rent-setting devices, but the text of that section (§ 98.1103) does not appear in this part, so nothing is extracted.
